# everyDock v0.4.0 — English on every display

A public beta focused on English presentation and documentation ahead of 1.0; existing preferences and Dock behavior are preserved.

## What's new since `v0.3.10`

- **An English interface throughout everyDock.** Settings, setup, menus, tooltips, accessibility labels, folder actions, preview controls, and app-owned messages now use English. Names and commands supplied by other apps, personal files, and macOS retain their source language.
- **A reorganized English README.** Installation, shortcuts, permissions, cleanup, platform limits, and development now have a navigable reference structure based on the owner’s agents-dev-skills conventions.
- **Current requirements and test documentation in English.** Requirement IDs and historical evidence remain traceable, with a separate v0.4.0 QA record.

Screen Recording still requires an explicit permission-button action when access is missing. Upgrades preserve pins and settings; uninstall/reinstall resets them. This remains an ad-hoc signed beta, not the 1.0 stable release.

## Install

```bash
brew tap hungryZoo/tap
brew trust --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock
brew install --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock
xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/everyDock.app
open -a everyDock
```

Existing users: quit everyDock, run `brew update` and `brew upgrade --cask hungryZoo/tap/everydock`, then repeat the `xattr` and `open` steps.

This release includes the Apple Silicon ZIP and `SHA256SUMS`. Download both to one directory and verify with `shasum -a 256 -c SHA256SUMS`. See [README](https://github.com/hungryZoo/everyDock#2-installation) and the [v0.4.0 QA record](https://github.com/hungryZoo/everyDock/blob/main/docs/QA-v0.4.0.md) for details and the exact validation scope.
